title: Tower Building of the Little Rock Arsenal

buildingCutout.basis: Native footprint of the former arsenal, now the MacArthur Museum.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged original park grade in the approach immediately north of the octagonal tower.

identities.name: Tower Building of the Little Rock Arsenal

names: Tower Building of the Little Rock Arsenal
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped historic survivor and original park grade, National Register exterior dimensions and the exact Qualla public-domain north elevation.

note: A two-story red-brick hall with a stone basement and pale two-story north galleries framing a three-story crenellated octagonal brick tower. Tall windows and chimney stacks flank the tower.
